facts.fact: The Bank of South Sudan issued a regulatory notice putting digital financial service providers, including mobile money operators, under the same licensing-linked requirements as banks, with licence suspension or cancellation as the sanction.
facts.system: Bank of South Sudan regulatory notice

facts.fact: The Bank of South Sudan issued a notice covering consumer protection for banks, microfinance institutions and digital financial service providers, requiring clear fee and loan disclosure, complaint contacts and no harassment or fraudulent deductions.
facts.system: Bank of South Sudan regulatory notice
